message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Operating Leverage Change", "construction": "Change in (Sales - Cost of Goods Sold) / Sales over the most recent quarter.", "rationale": "Firms with increasing operating leverage may experience greater earnings volatility, which could be rewarded with higher risk premia.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Post-Earnings Accruals Drift", "construction": "Sum of accruals in the two quarters following an earnings announcement, divided by average total assets.", "rationale": "Delayed market reaction to accrual quality can predict future returns after earnings events.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Insider Trading Activity", "construction": "Net purchases by insiders (number of shares bought minus sold) as a percent of shares outstanding over the past six months.", "rationale": "Insiders may possess private information about future prospects; high net buying could signal undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Growth Relative to Industry", "construction": "Trailing 12-month change in inventories divided by average inventories, minus the industry median of the same measure.", "rationale": "Firms growing inventories faster than peers may face future sales slowdowns or markdowns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "CEO Age", "construction": "Age of the firm's CEO as reported in company proxy statements.", "rationale": "Younger CEOs may be more likely to pursue growth opportunities or take risks that impact future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Volatility of Free Cash Flow", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly free cash flow (operating cash flow minus capital expenditures) over the past 3 years, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "High variability in free cash flow may be associated with riskier, potentially higher-return firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Debt Proportion", "construction": "Short-term debt divided by total debt as of most recent fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Firms relying more on short-term financing may face rollover risk, potentially earning higher risk premia.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Accounts Receivable Write-Off Ratio", "construction": "Write-offs of accounts receivable over the past year divided by total sales.", "rationale": "High write-off ratios may indicate aggressive revenue recognition or deteriorating customer quality.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Media Coverage Change", "construction": "Change in the number of major news articles mentioning the firm over the past year, normalized by previous-year coverage.", "rationale": "A sudden spike in media attention may reflect overreaction or attention-driven mispricing.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Filing Intensity", "construction": "Number of new patents filed in the past year divided by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with greater innovation activity may be investing in future growth, which could be underappreciated by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
